metadata.title: When You Accidentally 2-Kill but Your Brain Was Still Loading in Valorant
metadata.description:
My aim was on vacation but somehow got 2 kills.
Enemy probably uninstalling to question reality.
Valorant logic: ‘Sure, take these kills, we’ll explain later.’
Click if your aim ghosts but the kills keep rolling!

Hit like if your aim checked out but the kills didn’t!

#valorant #luckykills #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts
